english.title: Drive a vehicle while being unable to operate it in a proper and safe manner within a Mersey Tunnel
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnel approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

drove the vehicle after being informed by

(C)_[a Mersey Tunnels police officer]_
(D)_[an authorised officer]_

that in the opinion of that officer you were unable to operate the vehicle in a proper and safe manner
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(q) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
